description: Two donors in one lookup, each evaluated under its own locale. Chain.Alt exists in BOTH pl and en. The pl entry has no `translation` and a single alternative gated on `itemCount == CARDINALITY_FEW`, so when Polish rules do not say FEW the entry yields Optional.empty -- NO_MATCHING_ALTERNATIVE, which the default policy DOES continue past. The en entry is then evaluated under English rules, and its alternative is gated on `itemCount == CARDINALITY_OTHER`. A count therefore has to be classified twice, under two different locales, inside one getResult call. LocalizedStringLoader accepts a bare string as an alternative's value (parseLocalizedString's isString branch), so no nested {"translation": ...} wrapper is needed.

Chain.Alt.commentary: No default translation on purpose: an unmatched alternative here yields Optional.empty, which getResult records as NO_MATCHING_ALTERNATIVE -- the one failure reason the default fallback policy continues past.
